I replied in the thread in #inc-vtg-hartford. You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. I took that from the channel timestamps, which I assumed are UTC-5 like your message.

Your post said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan, and that the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. The channel doesn't say anything else about what the guard did until 11:03 AM. Mateo posted then that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836. You posted at 11:08 AM that both lanes were working as of 11:07.

So the clipboard was in use from 10:42 until kiosk 1 came back around 11:03. The channel doesn't show when the guard stopped using it for lane 2.
